description: Mint another API key for this workspace (shown once), optionally narrower than this one. A key can never grant scopes it does not itself hold, so this is the safe way to hand a limited key to another agent.

preset.description: Named scope bundle: full (everything), wiring (forms only, no submission access), readonly, triage

scopes.description: Explicit scopes, instead of a preset. Ignored where it would exceed the calling key's own scopes.
